title: queryOnce()
description: Runs a single, non-reactive query against a collection. Filters, ordering, and limits are pushed to PostgREST where possible. Operations like `groupBy`, `having`, and `distinct` are applied client-side after fetching.

params.name: callback
params.description: A query builder function describing the query to run once.

params.name: supabase
params.description: The Supabase client instance to run the query against.

examples.name: Run a one-time query
examples.code:
```tsx
import { queryOnce } from '@supabase-labs/tanstack-db'

const completed = await queryOnce(
  (q) => q.from({ todo: todos }).where(({ todo }) => eq(todo.completed, true)),
  supabase
)
```
